text:
Residents:
Felix and Aisha work weekdays 8:00-17:30. They leave the house around 09:00 and return in the evening. Felix typically returns at 18:00, while Aisha returns at 19:00. Both are home by 19:00. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day.

Object Locations (Current State, Mon 23:59):
Balcony: gloves, watering can, spray bottle (table).
Bathroom: detergent, laundry basket, Felix razor, toiletry bag, Aisha/Felix skincare (shelf); Aisha razor, soap, toothbrushes (sink); Aisha meds (cabinet); towels (rack).
Bedroom 1: ironing board (floor); Aisha laptop, Felix charger, Aisha notebook/pen, Felix laptop (desk); Felix hair dryer (bed); Aisha/Felix books, tablets, Aisha glasses, Aisha headphones (bed); empty wardrobe.
Entry: toolbox, vacuum (floor); Aisha/Felix jackets, scarves, backpacks, water bottles (hook); Aisha/Felix keys, wallets (table); Aisha/Felix shoes (rack).
Kitchen: kettle, knife block, toaster, wall clock, cutting board, spatula (counter); duster, Aisha/Felix glasses, mugs, bowls, plates, serving dish, pan, lunchbox, snack bowl (cupboard); Aisha/Felix water bottles (dish rack); kitchen knife (drawer); fruit bowl (table); shopping bag (pantry).
Living: cushions (armchair); board game, picture, speaker, vase (bookshelf); candle, coasters, tissue box, blanket, Aisha/Felix glasses, Aisha/Felix mugs, snack bowl, remote (coffee table); lamp (side table).
Office: empty.

Movement Patterns:
- Morning (08:00-09:00): Residents take work items (laptops, chargers, headphones, notebooks, pens, lunchboxes, water bottles) and outerwear (jackets, scarves, shoes, umbrellas, keys, wallets, backpacks) out of the house.
- Evening Return: Felix’s items appear in the entry at 18:00. Aisha’s items appear in the entry at 19:00.
- Kitchen (19:00-21:00): Cooking items (pans, knives, spatulas) move to the counter. Dishes (mugs, glasses, bowls, snack bowls) move to the sink, then to the cupboard by 21:00.
- Personal Items (21:00-22:00): Phones and headphones move to the bedroom (nightstand/bed/desk) for charging/bedtime. Water bottles move to the dish rack.
- Bedtime (22:00+): Books, tablets, and glasses move to the bed or nightstand.

Notes:
- Felix is home from 18:00; Aisha is home from 19:00 on weekdays.
- The shopping bag moves from the pantry to the counter during evening meal prep (20:00) and returns to the pantry by 21:00.
- Felix’s hair dryer was moved to the bed at 08:00 and remains there.
- Aisha’s glasses moved to the nightstand at 22:00.
- Phones are often "gone" (in pockets/bags) during the day and reappear in the bedroom in the evening.
